parts.name: barrel cradle

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey painted metal channel forming the main body and spine of the gun.
physics.Functional_description: Supports the cartridge tube and guides the plunger rod during operation.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical barrel section firmly from the side to stabilize the tool.
physics.reason: Sheet metal construction formed into a channel shape, enclosing air.

parts.description: Dark grey painted metal channel forming the main body and spine of the gun.
parts.function: Supports the cartridge tube and guides the plunger rod during operation.

parts.name: front collar

physics.Basic_description: Blue plastic ring at the front opening of the barrel cradle.
physics.Functional_description: Centers and retains the front of the caulking cartridge.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and peripheral for a primary grasp; avoid gripping here.
physics.reason: Molded plastic ring with a central hole for the cartridge nozzle.

parts.description: Blue plastic ring at the front opening of the barrel cradle.
parts.function: Centers and retains the front of the caulking cartridge.

parts.name: rear cap

physics.Basic_description: Blue plastic cap closing the rear end of the barrel assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a stop for the cartridge and houses the trigger mechanism pivot.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a functional grasp point; located at the extreme rear.
physics.reason: Molded plastic cover part, thin-walled.

parts.description: Blue plastic cap closing the rear end of the barrel assembly.
parts.function: Provides a stop for the cartridge and houses the trigger mechanism pivot.

parts.name: handle frame

physics.Basic_description: Yellow structural plastic frame forming the handle and trigger guard area.
physics.Functional_description: Main structural component for holding the gun and mounting the trigger.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary grasp location; wrap fingers around the handle frame securely.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic handle, likely ribbed or hollow to save weight.

parts.description: Yellow structural plastic frame forming the handle and trigger guard area.
parts.function: Main structural component for holding the gun and mounting the trigger.

parts.name: grip wing

physics.Basic_description: Orange soft-touch rubberized pad on the handle lever.
physics.Functional_description: Provides ergonomic comfort and high friction for the user's hand.
physics.Grasped_description: Excellent surface for gripper contact due to high friction properties.
physics.reason: Soft overmold or attached pad, effectively solid rubber material.

parts.description: Orange soft-touch rubberized pad on the handle lever.
parts.function: Provides ergonomic comfort and high friction for the user's hand.

parts.name: pivot pin

physics.Basic_description: Small dark metal pin visible at the trigger pivot point.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the axle for the trigger blade rotation.
physics.reason: Small metal dowel pin is solid material.

parts.description: Small dark metal pin visible at the trigger pivot point.
parts.function: Acts as the axle for the trigger blade rotation.

parts.name: cartridge tube

physics.Basic_description: Light blue cylindrical plastic tube containing the sealant.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the caulking material and transfers plunger force to the sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to steady the gun, but slippery plastic surface.
physics.reason: Standard extruded plastic cartridge tube, thin walls enclosing sealant/air.

parts.description: Light blue cylindrical plastic tube containing the sealant.
parts.function: Holds the caulking material and transfers plunger force to the sealant.

parts.name: cartridge label

physics.Basic_description: Magenta rectangular label adhered to the side of the cartridge tube.
physics.Grasped_description: Surface feature only, not a structural grasp point.
physics.reason: Thin sheet of paper/plastic film, treated as solid layer.

parts.description: Magenta rectangular label adhered to the side of the cartridge tube.

parts.name: nozzle cone

physics.Basic_description: Pink conical plastic tip attached to the front of the cartridge.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the flow of sealant out of the cartridge.
physics.Grasped_description: Fragile and small, avoid grasping to prevent breakage.
physics.reason: Hollow cone shape designed for fluid passage.

parts.description: Pink conical plastic tip attached to the front of the cartridge.
parts.function: Directs the flow of sealant out of the cartridge.

parts.name: white tip

physics.Basic_description: Small lime-green/white plastic cap at the very end of the nozzle.
physics.Functional_description: Seals the nozzle before use or cuts the flow.
physics.reason: Small molded tip, likely solid or thick-walled relative to size.

parts.description: Small lime-green/white plastic cap at the very end of the nozzle.
parts.function: Seals the nozzle before use or cuts the flow.

parts.name: plunger rod

physics.Basic_description: Teal colored metal rod extending from the rear of the gun.
physics.Functional_description: Pushes the internal plunger to dispense sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to manually retract or extend the rod.
physics.reason: Metal rod is typically solid or thick-walled tube acting as solid beam.

parts.description: Teal colored metal rod extending from the rear of the gun.
parts.function: Pushes the internal plunger to dispense sealant.

parts.name: cart plunger

physics.Basic_description: Brown circular disc inside the cartridge tube (visible in cutaway/end view).
physics.Functional_description: Seals against the tube wall and pushes the sealant forward.
physics.Grasped_description: Internal component, not accessible for grasping.
physics.reason: Solid plastic piston head.

parts.description: Brown circular disc inside the cartridge tube (visible in cutaway/end view).
parts.function: Seals against the tube wall and pushes the sealant forward.

parts.name: hook handle

physics.Basic_description: Maroon bent wire hook at the rear of the handle.
physics.Functional_description: Allows hanging the tool on a belt or rack.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be hooked by a gripper finger or grasped if necessary.
physics.reason: Solid metal wire rod.

parts.description: Maroon bent wire hook at the rear of the handle.
parts.function: Allows hanging the tool on a belt or rack.

parts.name: trigger blade

physics.Basic_description: Navy blue painted metal lever inside the handle frame.
physics.Functional_description: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger rod incrementally.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp between gripper fingers to simulate trigger pull.
physics.reason: Stamped metal plate, effectively solid for manipulation purposes.

parts.description: Navy blue painted metal lever inside the handle frame.
parts.function: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger rod incrementally.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
